ui.emptyHint: Drag game files onto this page or click to choose. Select all parts at once: they upload to the server and join the queue when all parts arrive.
ui.watchHint: Optional. Games arriving here automatically join the queue when all parts arrive. Browser uploads are also saved here (or in the data folder if unset).
ui.deleteOriginal: Delete original parts after the transfer is verified
ui.passwordsHint: one per line, tried before asking
ui.drop: Drop to upload to the server.
ui.sendNowHint: Start this one now. The current transfer returns to the queue and resumes where it stopped.
ui.retryHint: Retry (asks for the password again if incorrect)
ui.setupHint: First launch: choose a username and password (at least 8 characters) to access Ferry on this server.
ui.watchFolderPath: Or put files in the server’s watched folder: {0}
ui.wrongPasswordHint: The password did not open "{0}". Try again.
ui.notifyInsecure: System notifications need HTTPS (or localhost); notifications appear here on the page.
ui.notifyDenied: System notifications blocked in the browser.
ui.notifyDefault: System notifications when this tab is in the background.
ui.uploadQueued: Queued for upload to the server
ui.uploadDone: On the server. Joins the queue when all parts arrive.
ui.uploadRetry: No connection to the server, retrying… ({0})
ui.webhookHint: Notifies when a transfer finishes, fails, needs a password or installation is requested, even with the browser closed. No automatic retries.
ui.webhookLocaleHint: In Automatic mode, notifications use this browser's language when configuring the webhook. The URL may contain a token; protect settings.json.
ui.webhookSaveFirst: Correct the webhook fields before testing.
ui.pkgDirInvalid: Enter a PS5 path starting with /, without . or .. (e.g. /data/etaHEN/pkgs).
ui.pkgHint: Standalone PKG or one PKG per archive. By default, after upload, open etaHEN Toolbox > ★ Custom Background Package Installer on PS5 to install. Another folder may need Custom PKG Search Path. On some firmware versions, the manual installer also needs DPI v2 enabled.
ui.pkgSpaceHint: The PS5 may need space for both the PKG and the installed game.
ui.pkgCompatibilityHint: Recognizing the format does not confirm its signature, integrity or firmware compatibility. Follow installation in PS5 downloads.
ui.pkgRetentionHint: PKGs and their source archives are preserved. Removing from the queue does not delete the remote package or cancel installation on PS5.
ui.dpiHint: For Ferry, enable etaHEN Toolbox > Services > Direct Package Installer (9090), equivalent to DPI=1. Direct Package Installer V2 is a separate option. Request with the button or enable automatic mode. The test checks the port without installing anything.
ui.dpiSaveFirst: Correct the host and DPI port before testing.
ui.dpiTestFailed: DPI test failed: {0}. Check DPI=1 in etaHEN.
ui.requestInstallHint: Optional. Sends an explicit DPI request for the uploaded PKG. You can also install manually with ★ Custom Background Package Installer on PS5. An accepted request does not confirm completed installation.
ui.installConfirm: Check PS5 downloads before continuing. The request for "{0}" may have been accepted even without a reply. Resending may create another installation task. Resend the request?
ui.installRequestFailed: Could not request installation. Check the package state.
ui.installationText: Request accepted for {0}. Follow downloads on PS5.
ui.installationUnknownText: Check PS5 downloads for {0} before resending the request.
ui.packageReadyText: {0} uploaded. Open etaHEN Toolbox > ★ Custom Background Package Installer on PS5 to install manually.
ui.autoInstallPackagesHint: Off by default: only uploads the PKG; install on PS5 or request with the button. When on, a newly published upload triggers a DPI request; DPI must be active. Restored preparations and uncertain requests are never repeated.
ui.dpiHelpStep1: On PS5, open etaHEN Toolbox > Services and enable Direct Package Installer (9090). No PC program needs to be installed.
ui.dpiHelpStep2: In Ferry, enter the same PS5 IP, keep the DPI port at 9090 and click Test DPI. The test does not install a package.
ui.dpiHelpStep3: Then enable Request installation automatically via DPI for new uploads, or use the DPI button on an uploaded package.
ui.dpiHelpConfig: Alternatively, set DPI=1 in /data/etaHEN/config.ini and reload etaHEN to apply it. You can leave automatic mode off and install on PS5 instead.
ui.dpiHelpV2: Ferry uses DPI v1 on port 9090. Direct Package Installer V2 on port 12800 is a separate service; some firmware versions require it for ★ Custom Background Package Installer.
ui.dpiHelpCompatibility: Options and support depend on the etaHEN version and console firmware. Check the instructions for your version; an open port does not confirm installation compatibility.
